description: This file defines the CampaignsViewModulelistmenu class, which extends ViewModulelistmenu, and includes logic to retrieve and display recently viewed items related to campaigns, prospect lists, and prospects, including attaching item summaries and images.

classes.name: CampaignsViewModulelistmenu
classes.description: A view class that extends ViewModulelistmenu to display a list of modules with recently viewed items, tailored for campaign-related modules.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Retrieves recent viewing history for specific modules, processes each item to generate short summaries and associated images, and then renders the module list menu template.
